outlooks.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE FORECAST TO DEVELOP ACROSS THE SOUTHERN PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON WITH A MORE WIDESPREAD SEVERE THREAT POSSIBLE IN THE RED RIVER VALLEY AND NORTH TEXAS TONIGHT. LARGE HAIL...WIND DAMAGE AND A FEW TORNADOES MAY OCCUR. OTHER MARGINALLY SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS MAY DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS AND FROM THE MID MISSISSIPPI VALLEY INTO THE OHIO AND TENNESSEE VALLEYS.

sections.title: SRN AND CNTRL PLAINS/OZARKS/ARKLATEX
sections.text: AN IMPRESSIVE UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH WILL DIG SEWD ACROSS THE SRN ROCKIES TODAY AND INTO THE SRN PLAINS TONIGHT. AT THE SFC...A TROUGH WILL DEEPEN IN THE HIGH PLAINS AS A LOW DEVELOPS IN THE TX PANHANDLE THIS AFTERNOON. STRONG MOISTURE ADVECTION WILL TAKE PLACE ACROSS THE SRN PLAINS AS SFC DEWPOINTS INCREASE INTO THE LOWER TO MID 60S F FROM CNTRL AND NORTH TX NWD INTO SRN OK. ALTHOUGH A CAP IS FORECAST TO BE IN PLACE DURING THE DAY ACROSS PARTS OF THE SRN PLAINS...CELL INITIATION SHOULD FIRST TAKE PLACE ALONG A NARROW CORRIDOR OF INSTABILITY IN SW KS AND IN THE OK PANHANDLE WHERE LARGE-SCALE ASCENT WILL BE INCREASING AHEAD OF THE APPROACHING UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH. THIS CONVECTION SHOULD BE LOCATED ON THE EDGE OF A PLUME OF STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SUGGESTING ISOLATED LARGE HAIL MAY OCCUR LATE THIS AFTERNOON INTO EARLY THIS EVENING FROM SW KS SWD INTO THE ERN TX PANHANDLE AND WRN OK. AS THE UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH MOVES INTO THE SRN PLAINS FROM THIS EVENING INTO TONIGHT...WIDESPREAD THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT SHOULD TAKE PLACE WITH MCS DEVELOPMENT LIKELY ACROSS OK AND NORTH TX AFTER MIDNIGHT. MODEL FORECASTS SUGGEST THE MOST FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT FOR SEVERE STORMS WILL DEVELOP WELL AFTER MIDNI

sections.title: CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH WILL DEEPEN ACROSS THE SRN ROCKIES THIS AFTERNOON AS A COLD FRONT MOVES QUICKLY SWD ACROSS ERN CO. THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT WILL BE POSSIBLE ALONG THE FRONT EARLY THIS AFTERNOON WITH THIS CONVECTION MOVING QUICKLY SEWD INTO THE SRN HIGH PLAINS AHEAD OF THE UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH. FORECAST SOUNDINGS FOR LA JUNTA CO AT 21Z SHOW SOME INSTABILITY IN THE MID-LEVELS WITH UNIDIRECTIONAL WINDS AND A RELATIVELY DRY BOUNDARY LAYER. THIS MAY BE ENOUGH FOR HIGH-BASED CELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING MARGINALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS. COLD AIR ALOFT AND STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ASSOCIATED WITH THE UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH MAY ALSO RESULT IN SOME HAIL AS WELL.

sections.title: OH AND TN VALLEYS
sections.text: SOUTHWEST MID-LEVEL FLOW WILL BE IN PLACE TODAY FROM THE MS VALLEY EWD INTO THE OH AND TN VALLEYS. AT THE SFC...A WARM FRONT WILL ADVANCE NWD ACROSS THE OH AND TN VALLEYS THIS AFTERNOON. SFC DEWPOINTS SHOULD INCREASE INTO THE MID 60S F ACROSS MUCH OF TN AND KY AS A POCKET OF MODERATE INSTABILITY DEVELOPS THIS AFTERNOON. MODEL FORECASTS SUGGEST THAT THUNDERSTORMS WILL DEVELOP ALONG AN AXIS OF INSTABILITY FROM NRN MS NEWD INTO MIDDLE TN WITH THIS ACTIVITY SPREADING NEWD INTO KY DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON. FORECAST SOUNDINGS ALONG THIS CORRIDOR AT 21Z SHOW SBCAPE OF 1000 TO 1200 J/KG WITH 30 KT OF O-6 KM SHEAR. THIS COMBINED WITH STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES MAY RESULT IN A MARGINAL WIND DAMAGE THREAT WITH THE STRONGER MULTICELLS. HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE WITH THE MORE INTENSE UPDRAFTS. ..BROYLES/LEITMAN.. 10/12/2014

outlooks.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE FORECAST TO DEVELOP ACROSS THE CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON. THIS ACTIVITY WILL EXPAND AND BECOME MORE INTENSE WITH TIME THIS EVENING AND OVERNIGHT WHILE MOVING ACROSS PARTS OF NORTH TEXAS AND OKLAHOMA...EVENTUALLY REACHING ARKANSAS BY TOMORROW MORNING. DAMAGING WINDS ARE LIKELY. LARGE HAIL AND A FEW TORNADOES ALSO SHOULD BE EXPECTED.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: FALLING HEIGHTS AND MORE PRONOUNCED CYCLONIC FLOW ARE EXPECTED IN MIDDLE-UPPER LEVELS OVER MOST OF CENTRAL CONUS THROUGH PERIOD. SHORTWAVE TROUGH -- NOW EVIDENT IN MOISTURE-CHANNEL IMAGERY OVER UT -- IS EXPECTED TO DIG SEWD AND STRENGTHEN CONSIDERABLY...REACHING SERN CO AND ERN NM BY 00Z AND SRN KS...W-CENTRAL OK AND W-CENTRAL TX BY 12Z. BY THEN...CLOSED 500-MB LOW AND WELL-DEFINED PV ANOMALY SHOULD EXIST ALONG OK SEGMENT OF SHORTWAVE TROUGH. AT SFC...11Z ANALYSIS SHOWED WAVY/QUASISTATIONARY FRONTAL ZONE FROM ERN SC ACROSS NRN PORTIONS GA/AL THEN ARCHING ACROSS SERN AR...NWRN LA...E TX...TX COASTAL BEND...AND DEEP S TX. OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES ARE EVIDENT S OF FRONT FROM WRN GA ACROSS CENTRAL AL TO CENTRAL MS AND NRN LA. ONGOING CONVECTION IS OR RECENTLY HAS BEEN REINFORCING PARTS OF THOSE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES. NONETHELESS...WARM FRONT IS EXPECTED TO MOVE NWD ACROSS MID SOUTH AND LOWER OH VALLEY REGION THROUGH PERIOD WHILE BECOMING MORE DIFFUSE. WRN PORTION OF FRONTAL ZONE ALSO SHOULD BECOME ILL-DEFINED TODAY AND TONIGHT AS INTENSE LOW-LEVEL RETURN-FLOW/WAA REGIME SETS UP IN ADVANCE OF NEXT COLD FRONT. SFC CYCLOGENESIS/FRONTOGENESIS IS EXPECTED THROUGH EARLY AFTN OVER S-CENTRAL HIGH PLAIN

sections.title: CENTRAL/SRN HIGH PLAINS TO OZARKS AND ARLKATEX
sections.text: SCATTERED TO LOCALLY NUMEROUS TSTMS SHOULD FORM AND MOVE/EXPAND FROM W-E AND NW-SE ACROSS OUTLOOK AREA FROM LATE AFTN ONWARD...OFFERING DAMAGING GUSTS AND SPORADIC HAIL. ONCE SUBSTANTIAL RETURN-FLOW MOISTURE SUFFUSES FOREGOING WARM SECTOR TONIGHT...MOST LIKELY OVER SRN/ERN OK AND N-CENTRAL/NE TX...SLGT TORNADO RISK SHOULD COMMENCE -- ESPECIALLY WITH ANY RELATIVELY DISCRETE/PRE-FRONTAL CONVECTION ROOTED AT SFC OR WITH QLCS MESOVORTICES. CONVECTION THAT DEVELOPS THIS AFTN AND EARLY EVENING OVER CENTRAL/SRN HIGH PLAINS IS EXPECTED TO BE RELATIVELY HIGH-BASED WITH AT LEAST ISOLATED SVR DOWNDRAFTS AND HAIL POSSIBLE. ACTIVITY WILL BE OCCURRING IN ENVIRONMENT OF MRGL LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE...BUT ALSO STG DCVA/COOLING ALOFT...INTENSIFYING MID-UPPER WINDS AND DEEP SHEAR...AND STRENGTHENING FRONTOGENETIC FORCING. THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD BECOME MORE FRONTALLY TIED WITH TIME...EXPAND LATERALLY ON EITHER SIDE OF SFC LOW...AND IMPROVE ITS ORGANIZATION TONIGHT. FORCED ASCENT WILL PENETRATE OTHERWISE STG CAPPING TO LIFT INCREASINGLY HIGH-THETAE BOUNDARY-LAYER PARCELS INTO INCREASINGLY UNSTABLE MIDLEVELS AND GROW/MAINTAIN SVR MCS. E OF STRONGEST CAPPING...SEPARATE AREA OF WIDELY SCATTERED TO SCATTERED TST

sections.title: TN VALLEY REGION
sections.text: STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL WAA/MOIST-ADVECTION PLUME...DIURNAL/DIABATIC HEATING...CORRIDORS OF LOW-LEVEL CONFLUENCE/CONVERGENCE...AND INCREASING MOISTURE WILL SUPPORT SFC-BASED TSTM DEVELOPMENT OVER THIS AREA THIS AFTERNOON. TSTM CONCENTRATION AND AVAILABLE LOW-LEVEL LIFT/SHEAR EACH ARE LIKELY TO MAXIMIZE NEAR WARM FRONT AND OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES. AS HEIGHT GRADIENT ALOFT INCREASES ACROSS THIS REGION...AMIDST MORE CYCLONIC MID-UPPER WINDS...EFFECTIVE-SHEAR MAGNITUDES OF 30-40 KT AND EFFECTIVE SRH IN 150-250 J/KG RANGE MAY APPEAR IN POCKETS. THIS WILL SUPPORT BLEND OF MULTICELLULAR AND OCNL SUPERCELLULAR TSTM MODES. ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS AND HAIL NEAR SVR LEVELS ARE POSSIBLE...AND A TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT DEPENDING ON MESOSCALE/STORM-SCALE PROCESSES. ..EDWARDS/MOSIER.. 10/12/2014

outlooks.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE FORECAST TO DEVELOP ACROSS THE CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS LATER THIS AFTERNOON. A FAST-MOVING ARC OF STORMS WILL EVOLVE FROM KANSAS ACROSS OKLAHOMA AND INTO NORTH TEXAS OVERNIGHT...EVENTUALLY REACHING ARKANSAS BY MONDAY MORNING. SCATTERED DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL APPEAR POSSIBLE WITH THIS ACTIVITY. A TORNADO OR TWO CANNOT BE RULED OUT AS STORMS DEVELOP ACROSS SOUTHEAST OKLAHOMA AND NORTHEAST TEXAS PRIOR TO DAYBREAK.

sections.title: HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: A POTENT AND FAST-MOVING MID/UPPER IMPULSE WILL MOVE ACROSS CO/NM AND EMERGE OVER THE SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS BY EVENING. A COMPACT HEIGHT FALL CENTER WITH 500MB HEIGHTS FALLING 60-90M PER 12H WILL MOVE FROM SOUTHEAST CO TO TX/OK PANHANDLES THROUGH MIDNIGHT. AS THE MID-LEVEL TROUGH UNDERGOES SUBSTANTIAL AMPLIFICATION...SURFACE LOW WILL CONSOLIDATE NEAR KS/OK BORDER AND TRACK EAST. LIFT ALONG THE COLD FRONT TRAILING FROM THE LOW CENTER AND SURGING EAST/SOUTHEAST ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS THROUGH LATE EVENING SHOULD SERVE AS THE IMPETUS FOR INITIAL STORM DEVELOPMENT. THIS DEVELOPMENT WILL LIKELY OCCUR AMIDST A WARM BUT RELATIVELY DRY BOUNDARY LAYER FROM SOUTHEAST CO AND NORTHERN NM INTO ADJACENT AREAS OF KS AND TX/OK PANHANDLES. LATEST RAP SOUNDINGS ARE INDICATIVE OF HIGH-BASED STORMS ABOVE A DEEPLY-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER WHERE MLCAPE WILL BE AOB 500 J/KG AND EFFECTIVE VERTICAL SHEAR WILL NOT BE PARTICULARLY STRONG DURING THE LATER AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. POCKETS OF HIGHER FORECAST DCAPE APPROACHING 1000 J/KG IN THIS REGIME SUGGEST SCATTERED WIND DAMAGE POTENTIAL AS STORM COVERAGE GRADUALLY INCREASES.

sections.title: KS/OK/TX WEST OF I35 THROUGH MIDNIGHT
sections.text: INCREASINGLY FOCUSED FORCED ASCENT ALONG THE ADVANCING FRONT/WIND SHIFT SHOULD LEAD TO SQUALL LINE EVOLUTION THROUGH THE NIGHT. THIS WILL OCCUR COINCIDENT WITH SIGNIFICANT MASS ADJUSTMENTS OCCURRING IMMEDIATELY ABOVE A WEAKLY DECOUPLED AND CAPPED SURFACE-LAYER. CONVECTION WILL LIKELY INTENSIFY AS GREATER MOISTURE FLUX AND MUCAPE ARE REALIZED WITH SOUTHEASTWARD EXTENT. HOWEVER...LATEST FORECAST SOUNDINGS INDICATE SUBSTANTIAL CONVECTIVE INHIBITION IMMEDIATELY AHEAD OF THE FORCED CONVECTIVE LINE THAT SHOULD BE ADVANCING EAST/SOUTHEAST AROUND 40KT PER MEAN WIND/BUNKERS MOTIONS. TURBULENT MIXING AND PRECIPITATION LOADING ASSOCIATED WITH THE PASSAGE OF THE CONVECTIVE LINE WILL NO DOUBT LEAD TO GUSTY WINDS...PERHAPS EXCEEDING SEVERE CRITERIA OF 50KT IN A FEW LOCATIONS. LATEST INDICATIONS FROM STORM-SCALE GUIDANCE ARE THAT MOST CONVECTIVE WIND GUSTS SHOULD OCCUR IN THE RANGE OF 40-50KT OVERNIGHT.

sections.title: OK/TX/AR EAST OF I35 THROUGH EARLY MONDAY
sections.text: EVENTUALLY STRONG FORCING AND A LARGER AND DEEPENING CONVECTIVE COLD POOL MAY ACT ON A SUFFICIENTLY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER TO SUPPORT TRUE SURFACE-BASED STORMS. THIS LOOKS POSSIBLE ACROSS PORTIONS OF SOUTHEAST OK AND THE ARKLATEX DURING THE PRE-DAWN HOURS MONDAY. BREAKS IN THE CONVECTIVE LINE AND/OR EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS STRUCTURES WILL POSE BOTH WIND DAMAGE AND ISOLATED TORNADO THREATS DURING THIS PHASE OF THE OVERALL LARGER SYSTEM/S EVOLUTION. A SEPARATE BAND OF CONVECTION MAY ALSO EVOLVE IN INTENSIFYING WARM CONVEYOR BELT ACROSS CENTRAL TX LATE TONIGHT THROUGH EARLY MONDAY. GIVEN STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL JET TO 60KT DURING THIS DEVELOPMENT...SHEAR AND STORM MOTIONS WILL BE ADEQUATE FOR STRONGER WINDS AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO.

sections.title: MID-SOUTH/TN VALLEY TODAY
sections.text: SCATTERED STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO PERSIST WITHIN WARM AND MOIST AIRMASS FROM THE LOWER/MIDDLE MS VALLEY ACROSS THE TN VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON. WHILE A BELT OF STRONGER MID-LEVEL FLOW WILL CONTRIBUTE TO SUFFICIENT SHEAR FOR UPDRAFT PERSISTENCE AND ORGANIZATION IN THESE AREAS...LARGE SCALE SUPPORT APPEARS MARGINAL FOR MORE WIDESPREAD SEVERE STORMS. EXPECT A FEW MULTICELLULAR STORMS CAPABLE OF STRONG GUST AND PERHAPS MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL. ..CARBIN/COHEN.. 10/12/2014

outlooks.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE FORECAST TO INCREASE ACROSS THE CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. A FAST-MOVING ARC OF STORMS WILL EVOLVE FROM KANSAS ACROSS OKLAHOMA AND INTO NORTH TEXAS OVERNIGHT...EVENTUALLY REACHING ARKANSAS BY MONDAY MORNING. SCATTERED DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL APPEAR POSSIBLE WITH THIS ACTIVITY. A TORNADO OR TWO CANNOT BE RULED OUT AS STORMS DEVELOP ACROSS SOUTHEAST OKLAHOMA AND NORTHEAST TEXAS PRIOR TO DAYBREAK.

sections.title: 20Z UPDATE
sections.text: LITTLE CHANGE IN PRIOR FORECAST REASONING...SEE DISCUSSION BELOW AND SUBSEQUENT MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS. 5/15 PERCENT SEVERE RISK PROBABILITIES WERE EXTENDED FARTHER SOUTHWEST ACROSS PARTS OF WEST-CENTRAL TX/EDWARDS PLATEAU VICINITY IN ACCORDANCE WITH LATEST HRRR GUIDANCE AND ASSOCIATED EXPECTATIONS FOR THE POTENTIAL OF DUAL/SOMEWHAT SEPARATE CORRIDORS OF INCREASING THUNDERSTORMS LATER THIS EVENING AND OVERNIGHT. SEE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1851 REGARDING THE INITIAL SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT. OTHERWISE...LOW SEVERE PROBABILITIES PERSIST AS FAR EAST AS THE MID-SOUTH/TN VALLEY AND WINDWARD SOUTHERN APPALACHIANS. REFERENCE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1852 FOR AFTERNOON DETAILS ACROSS THESE REGIONS. ..GUYER.. 10/12/2014 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1132 AM CDT SUN OCT 12 2014/

SCATTERED DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL APPEAR POSSIBLE WITH THIS ACTIVITY. A FEW TORNADOES MAY ALSO OCCUR AS STORMS DEVELOP ACROSS SOUTHEAST OKLAHOMA AND NORTHEAST TEXAS PRIOR TO DAYBREAK.

sections.title: SRN AND CNTRL PLAINS
sections.text: AN IMPRESSIVE UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH WILL PROGRESS EWD ACROSS THE SRN PLAINS TONIGHT AS A 70 TO 85 KT MID-LEVEL JET ROUNDS THE BASE OF THE TROUGH. AT THE SFC...A LOW WILL MOVE ACROSS NRN OK AS A COLD FRONT ADVANCES QUICKLY EWD ACROSS THE SRN PLAINS. INCREASING LARGE-SCALE ASCENT AHEAD OF THE UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH WILL SUPPORT WIDESPREAD THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT AHEAD OF THE FRONT. AS A RESULT...A SQUALL-LINE IS EXPECTED TO BECOME BETTER DEVELOPED AFTER MIDNIGHT IN CNTRL AND ERN OK EXTENDING SWD INTO NORTH TX WHERE CELLS MAY TEND TO BE MORE DISCRETE. THIS LINEAR MCS IS FORECAST TO MOVE QUICKLY EWD TO NEAR THE AR STATELINE BY DAYBREAK EXTENDING SWWD INTO NE AND CNTRL TX. CONSIDERING THE SEVERE POTENTIAL...A 70 TO 85 KT MID-LEVEL JET CURRENTLY MOVING INTO THE SRN HIGH PLAINS...WILL HAVE AN IMPACT ON THE MAGNITUDE OF THE THREAT IN THE SRN PLAINS LATER TONIGHT. THE GREATEST SEVERE THREAT SHOULD EXIST FROM CNTRL OK SWD INTO NORTH TX BENEATH THE EXIT REGION OF THE APPROACHING MID-LEVEL JET LATE IN THE PERIOD. FORECAST SOUNDINGS FOR SRN OK AND THE DALLAS/FORT WORTH AT 09Z SHOW MLCAPE REACHING THE 1500 TO 2000 J/KG RANGE WITH 0-6 KM IN THE 45 TO 55 KT RANGE. THIS COMBINED ENHANCED LARGE-SCALE ASCE

sections.title: LOWER TO MID MS VALLEY/TN VALLEY
sections.text: THE LATEST WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS SOUTHWEST FLOW IN PLACE ACROSS THE LOWER TO MID MS VALLEY WITH A SUBTLE SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING THROUGH THE ARKLATEX. A CLUSTER OF STRONG THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING JUST AHEAD OF THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH IN SRN AR AND NRN LA. THE LATEST RAP DATA SHOWS AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY EXTENDING NWD ACROSS MS WHERE MLCAPE IS ESTIMATED IN THE 1500 TO 2000 J/KG RANGE. THIS COMBINED WITH 30 TO 40 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR EVIDENT ON REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS SHOULD BE SUPPORTIVE OF A MARGINAL SEVERE THREAT THIS EVENING. HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS MAY OCCUR WITH THE MORE INTENSE CELLS BEFORE THE SEVERE THREAT DIMINISHES LATER THIS EVENING. ..BROYLES.. 10/13/2014

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO ISOLATED SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL ACCOMPANY NUMEROUS HIGH-BASED STORMS SPREADING TO THE EAST-SOUTHEAST INTO EARLY EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 19Z SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACED A 996 MB CYCLONE NEAR THE OK PANHANDLE/SW KS BORDER...WITH A DRYLINE BECOMING BETTER DEFINED ACROSS THE ERN PANHANDLES S/SW ACROSS THE LOW ROLLING PLAINS TO THE LOWER PECOS VALLEY. STORMS HAVE BECOME INCREASINGLY NUMEROUS TO THE W OF THESE SURFACE FEATURES ACROSS SERN CO INTO N-CNTRL NM WITHIN A SWATH OF STRONGLY FORCED ASCENT IMMEDIATELY AHEAD OF THE POTENT SHORT-WAVE TROUGH SLIDING S/SE ACROSS THE SRN ROCKIES. ASSOCIATED INTENSE MID-LEVEL JET STREAK WILL CONTINUE TO SHIFT S/SE IN A SIMILAR MANNER THROUGH EARLY EVENING...LIKELY REMAINING DISPLACED S FROM THE HIGH-BASED TSTMS. NEVERTHELESS...MODERATELY STRONG 700-500 MB W/SWLYS AMIDST INVERTED-V THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES CHARACTERIZED BY 35-50 DEG F SURFACE DEW POINT DEPRESSIONS SHOULD FOSTER STRONG TO ISOLATED SEVERE WIND GUSTS. WITH SUCH SCANT BUOYANCY...UPDRAFTS SHOULD REMAIN LARGELY SKELETAL AND SEVERE GUST OCCURRENCE SHOULD BE TOO SPORADIC TO WARRANT WW ISSUANCE W OF THE DRYLINE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A BROAD AREA FROM THE LOWER MS VALLEY TO ERN TN WILL EXPERIENCE THE RISK FOR STRONG THUNDERSTORMS INTO THE AFTERNOON. WHILE A FEW MARGINALLY SEVERE STORMS CANNOT BE RULED OUT...THE ISSUANCE OF A WW WILL NOT BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SFC ANALYSIS PLACES A NWD-RETREATING BOUNDARY/WARM FRONT ARCING NEWD FROM CNTRL LA TO NERN MS...WITH THE BOUNDARY EXTENDING EWD INTO NORTH GA AS A STATIONARY FRONT. DIURNAL HEATING HAS YIELDED MLCAPE AROUND 1000-2000 J/KG S OF THE AFOREMENTIONED BOUNDARY...WHERE UPPER-60S SFC DEWPOINTS EXIST AND VIS SATELLITE IMAGERY HIGHLIGHTS DEEPENING PBL-CONVERGENCE- MANIFESTED CLOUD BANDS. ISOLATED TO SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO BLOSSOM/INTENSIFY FROM THIS ACTIVITY WITH ADDITIONAL DIURNAL HEATING. MEANWHILE...A LOOSELY ORGANIZED MULTICELL CLUSTER OVER NRN AL WILL CONTINUE TO SHIFT EWD...PERHAPS DEVELOPING FARTHER N INTO ERN TN TO THE N OF THE STATIONARY BOUNDARY IN A LESS-BUOYANT ENVIRONMENT. ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA...VWPS INDICATE 30-35 KT OF MID-LEVEL FLOW...WHICH WILL OFFER SUFFICIENT DEEP SHEAR FOR SUSTAINED MULTICELL STORMS WITH STRONG TO PERHAPS VERY LOCALLY/SPORADIC DMGG WIND GUSTS. MARGINALLY SVR HAIL COULD OCCUR WITH THE MOST INTENSE...INCIPIENT CORES. ALSO...A WEAK/BRIEF TORNADO CANNOT BE ENTIRELY RULED OUT IN PROXIMITY TO THE WARM FRONT...WHERE RELATIVELY BACKED SFC WINDS ARE ENHANCING 0-1-KM SRH. HOWEVER...POOR MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...WEAK DEEP ASCENT...AND WEAK LOW-LEVEL FLOW WILL ALL GREATLY MITIGATE ANY MORE SUBSTANTIAL SVR-TSTM POTENTIAL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: INITIALLY ISOLATED STORMS ALONG THE DRYLINE WILL POSE A RISK FOR MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL/WIND. STORM COVERAGE SHOULD BECOME WIDESPREAD THIS EVENING WITH A CORRESPONDING INCREASE IN SEVERE POTENTIAL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 20Z SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACED A 996 MB CYCLONE NEAR KLBL WITH A DRYLINE DRAPED S THROUGH THE ERN TX PANHANDLE AND LOW ROLLING PLAINS TO THE LOWER PECOS VALLEY. SURFACE DEW POINTS AHEAD OF THE DRYLINE REMAIN LOW /GENERALLY IN THE LOWER 50S/ N OF THE TX BIG COUNTRY SUPPORTING ONLY MEAGER BUOYANCY. NEVERTHELESS...STEEP TROPOSPHERIC LAPSE RATES AND INCREASINGLY STRONG FORCED ASCENT WILL AID IN INITIALLY ISOLATED STORMS ALONG THE DRYLINE BECOMING WIDESPREAD THIS EVENING. STRONG DEEP-LAYER WIND PROFILES WILL FAVOR HIGH-BASED SUPERCELLS WITH MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND WIND. THIS SHOULD TRANSITION TO A PREDOMINANT WIND RISK LATER IN THE EVENING AS A QLCS FORMS OVER WRN OK INTO NW TX.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR AN ISOLATED SVR TSTM OR TWO WILL EXIST ACROSS PORTIONS OF SERN TX DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. WW ISSUANCE WILL NOT BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SFC ANALYSES INDICATE THE NWD ADVANCE OF HIGHER THETA-E AIR S OF A WARM FRONT DRAPED NE/SW ABOUT 90-120 MILES INLAND FROM THE MIDDLE/UPPER TX COAST. DESPITE POOR MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER 70S ON THE WARM SIDE OF THIS BOUNDARY ARE ASSOCIATED WITH 1500-2500 J/KG OF MLCAPE...WITH RESULTANT INTENSE UPDRAFTS REVEALED BY 9-KM CAPPI DATA IN PROXIMITY TO THE BOUNDARY. THIS CONVECTION MAY CONTINUE TO DEVELOP INLAND AS PBL CIRCULATIONS DIURNALLY DEEPEN AMIDST WEAK CAPPING. A MODESTLY VEERING WIND PROFILE BELOW 3 KM AGL AND 30 KT OF 0-6-KM BULK WIND DIFFERENCE PER THE HGX VWP SUGGEST SOME POTENTIAL FOR CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION. AN ISOLATED INSTANCE OR TWO OF SVR WIND/HAIL CANNOT BE RULED OUT...WITH THE STRONG-SFC-WIND POTENTIAL ENHANCED BY 1.7-1.8-INCH PW /PER GPS DATA/ FAVORING WATER LOADING. HOWEVER...THE LACK OF STRONGER DEEP ASCENT...AND THE LACK OF STEEPER MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...ALONG WITH WEAK LOW-LEVEL FLOW...WILL LIMIT ANY MORE SUBSTANTIAL SVR-TSTM RISK.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED STORM DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE THIS EVENING. SHOULD INITIATION OCCUR...THE ENVIRONMENT WOULD SUPPORT A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND/OR LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 22Z MESOANALYSIS PLACED A DRYLINE FROM THE ERN TX PNHDL SSWWD TO W OF ABI TO W OF 6R6. INCREASED FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO THE POTENT SHORT-WAVE TROUGH AMPLIFYING OVER THE SRN ROCKIES HAS FOSTERED HIGH-BASED CONVECTION WITHIN THE DEEPLY MIXED STEEP-LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT W OF THE DRYLINE FROM NEAR MAF NEWD TO JUST NW OF ABI. LATEST RAP-BASED ANALYSES SUGGEST THAT THE AIR MASS E OF THE DRYLINE OVER THE TX BIG COUNTRY AND CONCHO VALLEY IS VIRTUALLY UNCAPPED WITH MLCAPE ESTIMATED IN THE 1000-2000 J/KG RANGE. RECENT RUNS OF THE HRRR INDICATE AN INCREASED POSSIBILITY OF STORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE DRYLINE WITHIN THE NEXT 1 TO 2 HOURS...PERHAPS AS THE AFOREMENTIONED HIGH-BASED CONVECTION DRIFTS E AND BECOMES ROOTED IN THE WARM SECTOR BOUNDARY LAYER. SHOULD THIS SCENARIO UNFOLD...THE COMBINATION OF MODERATE INSTABILITY AND 40-45 KT OF DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WOULD SUPPORT SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. IN THE EVENT EARLY EVENING STORMS DO NOT MATERIALIZE ALONG THE DRYLINE...TSTM DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE SEWD-MOVING COLD FRONT IS LIKELY TO OCCUR ACROSS AT LEAST NRN PARTS OF THE DISCUSSION AREA IN THE 03-05Z TIME FRAME. DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THESE STORMS. ..MEAD.. 10/12/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT WILL INCREASE FROM THE WEST THIS EVENING. A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED BY AROUND 13/01Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WATER VAPOR IMAGERY EARLY THIS EVENING SHOWS A VERY STRONG SHORTWAVE TROUGH/MID-LEVEL SPEED MAX DIVING SEWD ACROSS N-CNTRL NM AND THIS FEATURE IS FORECAST TO MOVE INTO THE TX S PLAINS VICINITY BY 13/04Z. STRONG UPPER-LEVEL FORCING FOR ASCENT...IN THE FORM OF DCVA ACCOMPANYING THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH...WILL RAPIDLY INCREASE THIS EVENING OVER THE CNTRL THIRD OF OK. LOW-LEVEL MASS RESPONSE WILL LIKEWISE INCREASE MARKEDLY THIS EVENING AS A 50 KT SLY LOW-LEVEL JET DEVELOPS OVER THE SRN PLAINS BY 13/03Z AIDING IN STRONG LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE TRANSPORT INTO THE REGION. SURFACE ANALYSIS EARLY THIS EVENING SHOWS DEWPOINTS RANGING FROM THE LOWER 50S OVER WRN OK TO THE UPPER 50S AND LOWER 60S OVER FAR S-CNTRL OK INTO ERN OK. A DRYLINE IS LOCATED OVER THE ERN TX PANHANDLE S OF A TRIPLE POINT LOW PRESSURE AREA OVER FAR NWRN OK. A PACIFIC COLD FRONT IS QUICKLY MOVING EWD /35-40 MPH/ ACROSS CNTRL PORTIONS OF THE TX PANHANDLE AND WILL OVERTAKE THE DRYLINE IN THE NEXT FEW HOURS. STRONG DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL SERVE TO ORGANIZE STORMS WHILE THE ADVECTION OF STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES INTO THE REGION FROM THE W WILL AID IN BOTH UPDRAFT VIGOR AND HAIL POTENTIAL WITH THE MORE DISCRETE STORMS OR POWERFUL UPDRAFTS EMBEDDED WITHIN A SQUALL LINE. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW MUCAPE RISING TO AROUND 2000 J/KG AS DEWPOINTS RISE THROUGH THE 50S AND INTO THE LOWER-MID 60S S OF I-40 PRIOR TO FRONTAL PASSAGE. HOWEVER THE RELATIVELY COOL SURFACE-1 KM LAYER BENEATH A CAPPING INVERSION SHOULD LIMIT THE TORNADO RISK...EXCEPT PERHAPS OVER SERN OK WHERE RICHER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WILL BE AVAILABLE. THE INITIAL ACTIVITY WILL INCLUDE THE POSSIBILITY FOR SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WINDS. AS THE DEEP FORCING FOR ASCENT AND SLAB-LIKE FRONTAL FORCING IMPINGE UPON WRN-CNTRL OK...A FAIRLY QUICK TRANSITION TO A F

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE WIND GUST POTENTIAL WILL PROBABLY BE HIGHEST OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS WITH CONVECTION NEAR AND AHEAD OF THE PACIFIC AND POLAR COLD FRONTS OVER THE ERN TX PANHANDLE AND TX LOW ROLLING PLAINS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SUBJECTIVE SURFACE MESOANALYSIS PLACES A TRIPLE POINT AREA OF LOW PRESSURE IN THE FAR NERN TX PANHANDLE WITH AN ATTENDANT DRYLINE EXTENDING SWD. A PACIFIC COLD FRONTAL SEGMENT IS MOVING ESEWD ACROSS SRN PORTIONS OF THE TX PANHANDLE AND THE TX S PLAINS. MEANWHILE A COLD FRONT OF POLAR ORIGINS IS BISECTING THE NW AND SE HALVES OF THE TX PANHANDLE. A QLCS-LIKE STRUCTURE HAS RECENT DEVELOPED ALONG THE PACIFIC FRONT ACROSS CNTRL PORTIONS OF THE TX PANHANDLE DRAPING SWWD INTO THE TX S PLAINS. MULTIPLE WEST TX MESONET SITES HAVE RECORDED 55-65 MPH GUSTS OVER THE PAST HOUR WITH PASSAGE OF THE MORE SUBSTANTIAL CONVECTION. AS THE LINEAR BAND OF STORMS CONTINUES TO PUSH ESEWD IN TANDEM WITH THE FRONT...THE CONVECTION WILL MOVE THROUGH A THERMAL RIDGE LOCATED NEAR THE CAPROCK E OF LBB NNEWD TOWARDS THE SERN TX PANHANDLE. THE STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WITHIN THE THERMAL RIDGE AND STRENGTHENING WIND FIELD WILL SUPPORT A CONTINUED RISK FOR SEVERE WIND GUSTS WITH THE CONVECTIVE LINE. FARTHER E OVER WRN OK AND FAR S-CNTRL KS...A FEW STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS WILL PROBABLY CONTINUE TO POSE SOME THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL/DMGG WINDS OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ..SMITH.. 10/12/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS...SOME STRONG...WILL CONTINUE INTO THE NIGHTTIME HOURS. SOME SMALL HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGEST STORMS...BUT THE OVERALL SEVERE THREAT WILL REMAIN LIMITED. AS SUCH...A WATCH IS NOT EXPECTED AT THIS TIME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE THUNDERSTORM CLUSTER ACROSS SE AR AND NE LA WILL CONTINUE TO LIFT TO THE N/NE TONIGHT. THIS CLUSTER WILL BE MAINTAINED ON THE EASTERN FRINGES OF AN INCREASING S/SWLY LLJ AND STRONGER WAA ASSOCIATED WITH SEWD DIGGING MID AND UPPER LEVEL TROUGH OVER THE SOUTHERN PLAINS. WHILE THE ENVIRONMENT WILL REMAIN WEAKLY UNSTABLE WITH STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR IN PLACE...WEAK TO MODERATE SBCINH WILL LIMIT SURFACE BASED CONVECTION AND STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO REMAIN ELEVATED. 00Z LZK RAOB INDICATED MODEST MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AROUND 6.5 DEG C PER KM AND 500 MB TEMPS NEAR -11 DEG C...WHICH MAY ALLOW FOR SOME SMALL HAIL IN STRONGER STORMS. STRONG/DAMAGING WINDS ARE NOT EXPECTED GIVEN LOW LEVEL CAPPING...BUT SOME GUSTY/SUB-SEVERE WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE GIVEN FAST STORM MOTION AND HIGH PW. GIVEN MARGINAL/EXPECTED LOW-END NATURE OF THE THREAT A WATCH IS NOT EXPECTED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR 50-70 MPH WIND GUSTS WILL PROBABLY INCREASE AND BECOME WIDESPREAD ACROSS PORTIONS OF SWRN AND INTO CNTRL OK DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS AS A CONVECTIVE LINE TRACKS EWD THROUGH THE REGION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC IMAGERY DURING THE PAST 30-60 MINUTES HAS SHOWN A FAIRLY RAPID INTENSIFICATION IN CONVECTIVE INTENSITY AS SHOWN IN THE OVERALL DEEPENING OF REFLECTIVITY STRUCTURE IN HEIGHT AND MAGNITUDE. RAPID NWD TRANSPORT OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE IS UNDERWAY ACROSS N-CNTRL TX INTO OK WITH AN AXIS OF LOWER 60S DEWPOINTS E OF THE QLCS FROM THE RED RIVER NWD TO I-40. 02Z SUBJECTIVE SURFACE MESOANALYSIS PLACES THE COLD FRONT APPROXIMATELY 25 MI TO THE W OF THE LEADING EDGE OF THE QLCS GUST FRONT. AN INVERTED TROUGH EVIDENT BY A SURFACE WIND SHIFT APPEARS TO LARGELY BE PARALLELING THE I-44 CORRIDOR FROM NEAR OKC NEWD TO TUL. AS THE INTENSE MID-LEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH/SPEED MAX APPROACHES THE SRN PLAINS...FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL MAXIMIZE TONIGHT COINCIDENT WITH THE FRONTAL FORCING EVENTUALLY REACHING THE W EDGE OF THE WARM SECTOR OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. AS A RESULT...THE SQUALL LINE WILL LIKELY STRENGTHEN AND THE PROPENSITY FOR SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL BE MAINTAINED OR INCREASE...ESPECIALLY INVOF ANY DEEPER CORES OR WITH MESOVORTICES THAT DEVELOP AS THE LINE MATURES NEAR AND S OF THE INVERTED TROUGH OVER CNTRL OK. FARTHER S OVER WRN N-CNTRL TX...EXPECTING THE GRADUAL ZIPPERING SWD OF THE QLCS WITH STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS BECOMING THE PREDOMINATE THREAT WITH THIS ACTIVITY. HOWEVER...THE STRONG SLY LOW-LEVEL JET AND ISENTROPIC ASCENT WILL AT LEAST SUPPORT THE NOTION FOR STORMS TO DEVELOP AHEAD OF THE LINE AND POSE PRIMARILY A LARGE HAIL THREAT WITH THE MORE INTENSE STORMS. THE SEVERE THREAT APPEARS TO BE LESS OVER NRN OK AND SRN KS DUE IN PART TO ONLY LOWER-MID 50S DEWPOINTS AND A LESS UNSTABLE AIRMASS RESIDING IN THIS REGION. PERHAPS A FEW STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS MAY POSE A MARGINAL LARGE HAIL THREAT THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ..SMITH.. 10/13/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRA

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT INCLUDING THE POSSIBILITY OF LARGE HAIL...SEVERE WIND GUSTS...AND PERHAPS A TORNADO OR TWO...WILL INCREASE TONIGHT AS STORMS MOVE FROM THE WEST AND INTO THE AREA. A CONVECTIVE WATCH WILL LIKELY BE REQUIRED WITHIN AN HOUR OR SO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC IMAGERY SHOWS STORMS INTENSIFYING OVER THE TX LOW ROLLING PLAINS WITHIN A QLCS WITH SEVERAL STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS CLUSTERED AHEAD OF THE MAIN LINE. A COLD FRONT WILL MERGE WITH THE CONVECTIVE LINE OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO AND ACCELERATE ESEWD ACROSS N-CNTRL TX TONIGHT. THE MAIN THREAT WITH THE QLCS WILL BE SEVERE WIND GUSTS POSING A WIND DAMAGE HAZARD. THE PRESENCE OF A STRONG LLJ/WAA REGIME CONTRIBUTING TO INCREASING LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE LENDS THE POSSIBILITY FOR A SURFACE-BASED SUPERCELL THREAT AND ASSOCIATED ALL SEVERE HAZARDS LATE TONIGHT. SURFACE OBSERVATION TRENDS SHOW THE MARITIME TROPICAL AIR OVER THE UPPER TX COASTAL PLAIN HAS GRADUALLY MOVED NNWWD UP THE I-45 CORRIDOR...WITH UPPER 60S DEWPOINTS NEAR AND S OF THE METROPLEX. INCREASINGLY STRONG LOW-LEVEL WIND FIELDS AND AN ADEQUATELY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER MAY AID IN AT LEAST SOME POSSIBILITY FOR A CONDITIONAL SUPERCELL TORNADO RISK IF AN APPRECIABLY LARGE AMOUNT OF SBCINH CAN BE OVERCOME. NONETHELESS...AT LEAST THE WIND DAMAGE/LARGE HAIL THREAT WILL GENERALLY INCREASE FROM WEST TO EAST TONIGHT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLD SEVERE THREAT IS POSSIBLE. UNCERTAINTY REMAINS REGARDING THE POSSIBILITY FOR ROBUST SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS A WEAK SHORTWAVE TROUGH IN THE SRN STREAM MOVING NEWD ACROSS THE LOWER MS RIVER VALLEY EARLY TONIGHT WHICH APPEARS LARGELY RESPONSIBLE FOR THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY EARLIER TODAY ACROSS THIS REGION. AN INCREASE IN MID-LEVEL FLOW HAS BEEN OBSERVED BY THE KDGX VAD FROM 00Z THROUGH PRESENT TIME AS WINDS HAVE STRENGTHENED FROM 30 TO 50 KT AROUND 4KM AGL. RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS A CLUSTER OF STRONGER THUNDERSTORMS ON THE SRN FRINGE OF A LARGE CONVECTIVE SHIELD OVER NRN MS AND INCLUDING ADJACENT PORTIONS OF AL AND TN. 04Z SURFACE OBSERVATIONS OVER CNTRL MS TO THE INFLOW SIDE OF THE UPDRAFTS ON THE S-SIDE OF THE CONVECTIVE CLUSTER SHOW TEMPS IN THE MID 70S AND DEWPOINTS NEAR 70 DEG F. MODIFYING THE 00Z JAN RAOB SUGGESTS AROUND 1000 J/KG MLCAPE EXISTS WITHIN A LOW-LEVEL VEERING AND STRENGTHENING WIND PROFILE WITH HEIGHT. AS SUCH...THE POSSIBILITY FOR STORMS TO STRENGTHEN AND BECOME SUPERCELLS IS NOT OUT OF THE QUESTION. WHILE NOT LIKELY AT PRESENT TIME...IF FURTHER STORM INTENSIFICATION BECOMES APPARENT...A TORNADO WATCH MAY BE CONSIDERED. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SQUALL LINE POSING PRIMARILY A WIND DAMAGE RISK WILL MOVE INTO ERN OK OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS A QLCS MOVING EWD AROUND 30 KT ACROSS CNTRL OK. LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE ADVECTION CONTRIBUTING TO DESTABILIZATION COMBINED WITH STRONG FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL LIKELY MAINTAIN THIS QLCS AS IT MOVES EWD INTO ERN OK. STRONG TO LOWER-END SEVERE WIND GUSTS APPEAR TO BE THE PRIMARY HAZARD. CURRENT EXTRAPOLATION HAS THE QLCS APPROACHING THE ERN EDGE OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 530 BY THE 0630Z TIMEFRAME. AS A RESULT...A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL LIKELY NEED TO BE CONSIDERED BY 0600Z-0630Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE WEATHER THREAT...PRIMARILY STRONG TO DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...WILL SPREAD FROM WEST TO EAST INTO THE ERN HALF OF OK /FROM WW 529 INTO WW 532/...AND SSEWD ACROSS THE BIG COUNTRY AND CONCHO VALLEY PORTIONS OF TX. COUNTIES IN THE WAKE OF THE PRIMARY LINE OF STORMS CAN BE REMOVED FROM THE RESPECTIVE WATCHES. MEANWHILE...THE SEVERE THREAT IS ADVANCING INTO THE CONCHO VALLEY...SUCH THAT WFO SJT HAS EXPANDED THE AREAL COVERAGE OF WW 530. GIVEN THE FORWARD ADVANCEMENT OF THE TSTMS...WW 529 SHOULD BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE AS SCHEDULED BY 08Z...WHILE SOME OF THE COUNTIES ADDED TO WW 530 MAY NEED TO BE EXTENDED TEMPORALLY BEYOND 08Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 620Z...MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED A LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS...WITH AN EMBEDDED STRONG TO SEVERE STORM POTENTIAL...EXTENDING FROM THE ERN EXTENT OF WW 529...THEN SSWWD THROUGH NORTH TX /IN THE NORTHWEST PART OF TORNADO WATCH 531/...AND TRAILING SWWD THROUGH THE SERN PART OF WW 530 AND TO THE N AND NW OF KSGT. THESE STORMS ARE LOCATED WITHIN THE LEADING EDGE OF DEEP-LAYER FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO AN AMPLIFYING...VIGOROUS SHORTWAVE TROUGH DIGGING SEWD INTO THE SRN PLAINS PER MOISTURE-CHANNEL IMAGERY. THIS WILL CONTRIBUTE TO FURTHER STRENGTHENING OF DEEP-LAYER SSWLY WINDS FROM CENTRAL AND EAST TX INTO ERN OK/WRN AR. DEEP-LAYER ASCENT COUPLED WITH INCREASING LOW-LEVEL WAA ALONG THE STRENGTHENING SSWLY LLJ /UP TO 50-60 KT/ WILL MAINTAIN A QLCS. FURTHER LOW-LEVEL MOISTENING/INCREASING THETA-E AND SUBSEQUENT DESTABILIZATION SHOULD INCREASE THE POTENTIAL FOR SURFACE-BASED PARCELS AND THE POTENTIAL FOR STRONGER-MOMENTUM AIR TO REACH THE SURFACE AS THE TSTMS ADVANCE EWD/SEWD. TRENDS IN MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY INDICATED THE N-S ORIENTED LINE SEGMENTS IN COAL/ATOKA COUNTIES OK AND COOKE/DENTON COUNTIES TX WERE TRACKING EWD AT 44 KT WHILE A STORM MOVING EWD THROUGH NWRN COLEMAN AND CALLAHAN COUNTIES TX HAD A SPEED NEAR 40 KT. THIS ACTIVITY AND SIMILAR N-S LINE SEGMENTS SHOULD HAVE AN INCREASING SEVERE WIND THREAT AT THE SURFACE...GIVEN THE AFOREMENTIONED ONGOING DESTABILIZATION/FAVORABLE THERMODYNAMICS AND APPROACHING DEEP-LAYER FORCING FOR ASCENT. ..PETERS.. 10/13/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR SEVERE STORMS...PRIMARILY DAMAGING WINDS AND A FEW TORNADOES...WILL PERSIST FROM WEST TO EAST ACROSS THE VALID PORTION OF WW 531...WHILE COUNTIES IN THE WAKE OF THE PRIMARY LINE OF STORMS CAN BE REMOVED WITH THE PASSAGE OF THIS ACTIVITY. A NEW TORNADO WATCH IS LIKELY TO THE EAST OF WW 531 BY 09Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 740Z...MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED A PRIMARY LINE OF STORMS MOVING EWD THROUGH ERN OK TO THE RED RIVER VALLEY...AND TRAILING SWWD THROUGH THE DALLAS/FORT WORTH METROPLEX TO THE CONCHO VALLEY. MEANWHILE...JUST AHEAD OF THIS LINE IN NORTH TX /FANNIN AND HUNT COUNTIES/ A SECOND LINE OF STORMS HAD DEVELOPED...AND A SEPARATE CLUSTER OF STORMS PERSISTED FROM IN VICINITY OF WACO SWWD TO CORYELL COUNTY. TRENDS IN SURFACE OBSERVATIONS AND OBJECTIVE ANALYSES INDICATED THE PRE-CONVECTIVE WARM SECTOR WAS DESTABILIZING AS EXPECTED WITHIN MOISTURE RETURN ALONG A STRENGTHENING SSWLY LLJ...AHEAD OF THE DIGGING/AMPLIFYING MIDLEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH. THE INCREASE IN THETA-E AND RISING SURFACE TEMPERATURES OVER THE ERN PART OF WW 531 INTO NWRN LA/SWRN AR FURTHER REPRESENT ONGOING DESTABILIZATION WITH AN INCREASING LIKELIHOOD FOR SURFACE-BASED STORMS INTO THE EARLY MORNING. AS THE STRENGTHENING LLJ SHIFTS EWD INTO EAST TX...ERN OK...NWRN LA AND AR THROUGH 12-15Z...LOW-LEVEL SHEAR WILL SUBSEQUENTLY INCREASE WITH EFFECTIVE SRH OF 300-400 M2/S2 PERSISTING FOR LOW-LEVEL STORM ROTATION AND INCREASE IN THE TORNADO THREAT INTO THE PRE-DAWN HOURS AND EARLY MORNING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE WEATHER THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS WW 533...WHILE THE THREAT ACROSS WW 531 HAD GREATLY DIMINISHED SUCH THAT THIS LATTER TORNADO WATCH WAS CANCELLED EARLY. A NEW TORNADO WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED ACROSS THE REST OF NRN LA INTO ERN AR...WRN/NRN MS...WRN TN...AND THE MO BOOTHEEL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY CONTINUED TO SHOW A SSW-NNE ORIENTED CONFLUENCE CORRIDOR EXTENDING FROM BRAZOS TO SMITH COUNTIES TX WHERE IT INTERSECTED THE PRIMARY EWD MOVING LINE OF STORMS...WHICH THEN EXTENDED NWD THROUGH NERN TX TO WRN AR. THE STORMS EXTENDING SWWD FROM SMITH COUNTY TX TO IN VICINITY OF KIMBLE COUNTY TX HAD BECOME MORE ELEVATED AS THEIR ATTENDANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY MOVED TO THE SSE. MEANWHILE...SURFACE TEMPERATURES HAVE CONTINUED TO RISE ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR FROM EAST TX AND WRN LA THROUGH CENTRAL/ERN AR AND WRN MS. THIS COMBINED WITH A NWD TRANSPORT OF RICH MOISTURE /SURFACE DEW POINTS TO AROUND 70 NOW INTO THE SRN AR AND CENTRAL MS/ IS CONTRIBUTING TO DESTABILIZATION WITH NWD EXTENT ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA. THESE TRENDS ARE EXPECTED TO PERSIST THIS MORNING RESULTING IN WEAKENING SURFACE-BASED INHIBITION. FURTHER STRENGTHENING OF DEEP-LAYER SSWLY WINDS WILL SUSTAIN THE EWD MOVING QLCS AS THE MIDLEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH SHIFTS ENEWD ACROSS OK WITH DAMAGING WINDS BEING THE PRIMARY THREAT. HEIGHT FALLS SPREADING INTO THE DISCUSSION AREAS AND LOW-LEVEL WAA SHOULD AID IN WEAKENING ANY REMAINING EARLY DAY CAPPING FOR AN INCREASING TREND FOR SURFACE-BASED STORMS. GIVEN THIS FACTOR AND HIGH THETA-E AIR/LOW LCLS IN THE PRESENCE OF STRONG LOW-LEVEL SHEAR... A TORNADO THREAT CONTINUES TO BE SUFFICIENT FOR A TORNADO WATCH VERSUS A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A THREAT FOR STRONG TO DAMAGING WIND GUSTS CONTINUES ACROSS THE REMAINING VALID PORTIONS OF WW 532...EAST OF A LINE FROM STONE COUNTY MO TO PIKE COUNTY AR. THE ERN PART OF WW 532 MAY BE INCLUDED IN A NEW TORNADO WATCH AS DESCRIBED IN SPC MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1865.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED A LINE OF STORMS EXTENDING FROM CENTRAL/SWRN MO SWD THROUGH WRN AR. THIS LINE WAS MOVING EWD AT 20-30 KT...WHILE EMBEDDED BOWING LINE SEGMENTS WERE TRACKING TO THE NORTHEAST AT 40-45 KT. STRONGEST SURFACE PRESSURE FALLS ARE IN SRN MO WITH THE AREA OF LOW PRESSURE IN CENTRAL TO NERN OK EXPECTED TO TRACK INTO MO TODAY. THESE PRESSURE FALLS ARE ALSO SUPPORTING AN ISALLOBARIC RESPONSE SUCH THAT SURFACE WINDS IN SERN MO AND ERN AR ARE REMAINING FROM THE SOUTHEAST...ENHANCING LOW-LEVEL SHEAR FOR THE TORNADO THREAT. MEANWHILE...THE CONTINUED FAST NEWD STORM MOTIONS AND FURTHER DESTABILIZATION THIS MORNING WITH EWD EXTENT ACROSS WW 532 WILL SUPPORT THE THREAT FOR STRONG/DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. ..PETERS.. 10/13/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
